properties.information:
The restricted access permit system has now been lifted following a positive geotechnical safety assessment. While permits are no longer required for travel on Mount Spec Road, the daytime vehicle escort system will continue to operate on the hour every hour between 6am and 6pm. The Road will be closed between 6pm to 6am. The little Crystal Creek picnic area and carpark remain closed while reconstruction works are ongoing. The geometry of the road in conjunction with the ongoing works means the road is not suitable for all vehicles. The types of vehicles deemed suitable have not changed since the permit system was removed - if a vehicle was previously allowed, it remains suitable. As a guide:
·       Vehicles with small trailers are suitable – for example, a dual cab 4WD towing a box trailer.
·       Larger trailers are not suitable – including larger caravans and similar long or heavy trailer combinations.

properties.information:
The Mudgeeraba Creek Causeway on Gold Coast–Springbrook Road is being replaced with a higher structure. 
The causeway sustained damage during heavy rainfall associated with Ex-Tropical Cyclone Alfred in March 2025.
The replacement structure will include:
•	new concrete box culverts about 2.5 metres higher than the current structure 
•	new pavement on approaches to the causeway.
The replacement structure is being built upstream of the existing structure.
What to expect:
•	Reduced speed limit to 40km/h with intermittent single lane operation.
•	Work hours will be from 6am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday with Sunday and night works as required.

properties.information:
The Brisbane Roar FC and Perth Glory soccer game will be held at Suncorp Stadium on Friday 23 from 7pm.
Roads closed for 2.5 hours before and 1 hour after 
the event are:
• Milton Rd inbound between Park Rd and 
Castlemaine St
• Castlemaine St between Heussler Tce and 
Black St
• Chippendall St, Finchley St, Mayneview St, 
and Parkview St, excepting local traffic.
Other partial closure will be in place for 3 hours before 
and 1 hour after the event are Petrie Tce between Milton Rd and Caxton 
St, and
• Upper Roma St inbound between Skew St 
and Countess St
Motorists attending the event should also be aware 
of the 15-minute parking restriction that applies to the 
Suncorp Traffic Area on match days. Coronation 
Drive and Hale St will remain open. Re-directional 
signs will be placed on the major routes approaching 
the stadium.
